definitions.explanation: Describes someone with a strong, durable physical constitution that resists illness and hardship. Suggests rugged health and resilience.

examples.japanese: {頑健|がんけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{頑健|がんけん}で、⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧ひとつ⟦{引|ひ}かない→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother is robust and never catches a cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鍛|きた}えられた→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧{頑健|がんけん}な⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a hardy body built through farm work.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {頑健|がんけん}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧.

NUANCE: {頑健|がんけん} emphasizes durable, resilient strength - the ability to withstand hardship and resist illness. It suggests a rugged quality built through physical work or inherited constitution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頑健|がんけん}な⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧/⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧ (sturdy body)
- {頑健|がんけん}な⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧ (robust build)
- {頑健|がんけん}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (hardy person)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧ (healthy, strong - more common)
- ⟦{屈強|くっきょう}→屈強：09198_kukkyou⟧ (brawny, sturdy - more muscular)
- ⟦{壮健|そうけん}→壮健：09195_souken⟧ (healthy, robust - more formal)
- ⟦{虚弱|きょじゃく}→虚弱：09196_kyojaku⟧ (weak, feeble - opposite)
